slides.title: Drill 3 Overview: Accident Management - Training IDs 1.8-1.10
content: Prerequisite: Must complete Drill 2 (Training IDs 1.5-1.7) first
This drill covers 3 sequential training scenarios:
• Training ID 1.8: Burns Assessment and Management
• Training ID 1.10: Poisoning Identification and Treatment
Each scenario must be completed before proceeding to the next.

slides.title: Training ID 1.8: Burns Assessment and Management
content: • Calculate total body surface area affected

slides.title: Training ID 1.9: Electrical Injury Management
content: • Apply safe rescue and treatment protocols

slides.title: Training ID 1.10: Poisoning Identification and Treatment
Drill 3 Practical Procedures
content: • Practice burn assessment using rule of nines

slides.title: Drill 3 Assessment: Training IDs 1.8-1.10
content: Red: Does not meet minimum expectations.
Amber: Meets and demonstrates the basic requirements.
Green: Meets and demonstrates a thorough understanding.
• Show competency in electrical injury management
All 3 training scenarios (1.8-1.10) must be completed successfully before proceeding to Drill 4.
